header.title: Pagination
header.description: Splits a long list into pages and lets people move between them. It includes the result range (`1–10 of 87`), the page buttons and a page-size selector. Use it below tables and lists when showing everything at once would be too much. It renders a `<nav>` with a list of buttons.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and the code instantly. With `total` at 480 or 5000 and different `siblingCount` and `boundaryCount` values you can see how pages are trimmed.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: It only needs `total`, the total number of items. It computes the pages from the page size (10 by default) and manages the current page on its own. All texts default to English, so these examples pass them translated with a `paginationLabels` helper that groups `navLabel`, `pageSizeLabel`, the button labels, `pageLabel` and `showSummary`.

rows.title: With rows
rows.description: The typical case: keep `page` and `pageSize` in your state and slice the list with them. When the page size changes, go back to page 1. `pageSizeOptions` sets the selector options.

firstLast.title: First and last
firstLast.description: `showFirstLast` (on by default) adds buttons to jump to the first and last page. With `false` only previous and next remain. They are hidden on narrow screens anyway.

manyPages.title: Many pages
manyPages.description: With many pages, the middle ones are replaced by an ellipsis. `siblingCount` sets how many pages show on each side of the current one and `boundaryCount` how many stay fixed at the start and end.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the button height and text size: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`. It also applies to the page-size selector.

ghost.title: Variants
ghost.description: `outlined` (default) joins the buttons in a bordered bar. `ghost` separates them, without borders or dividers; the current page stays highlighted.

hiddenPageSize.title: Without page-size selector
hiddenPageSize.description: `showPageSize={false}` hides the selector. Use it when the page size is fixed.

customSummary.title: Custom summary
customSummary.description: `showSummary` accepts a function that receives the range (`start`, `end`, `total`, `page`, `pageSize` and `pageCount`) and returns the text. With `false` it is hidden.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` disables every button and the selector, for example while data loads.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `page` and `onPageChange` the page lives in your state, so you can change it from outside. The same goes for `pageSize` and `onPageSizeChange`.

mobile.title: Small screens
mobile.description: Pagination measures its own width and compacts itself. Up to 768px the first and last buttons hide, the bar takes the full row and fewer pages show. Up to 480px only the first, current and last remain. Also, in windows narrower than 1024px the bar moves to its own row. These boxes simulate a tablet and a phone.

header.title: Pagination API
header.description: API reference for the Pagination React component: props, texts, range, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of the <nav> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>), except onChange and defaultValue. The buttons are gem-system Buttons and the selector is a Select. classNames adds classes to each part: root, summary, controls, list, item, ellipsis and pageSize.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.landmark: The root is a <nav> with navLabel as its aria-label.
a11y.buttons: Each page is a button with pageLabel(page) as its aria-label, so it is announced as "Page 3" instead of just "3".
a11y.edges: The first, previous, next and last buttons use firstLabel, previousLabel, nextLabel and lastLabel, and are disabled at either end.
a11y.keyboard: With focus inside the component, the left and right arrows change page, and Home and End go to the first and last. It doesn't apply inside the selector.
a11y.summary: The summary has aria-live="polite", so screen readers announce the new range when the page changes.
a11y.pageSize: The selector is named by the visible pageSizeLabel text through aria-labelledby.
a11y.ellipsis: The ellipses have aria-hidden and are not read.
a11y.labels: All texts default to English ("Pagination", "Rows per page", "Page 1", "1–10 of 87"). Pass them translated if your app uses another language.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: `<nav>` element. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Defines the Pagination variables.
rules.size: Applied based on `size`. Sets the text and button size.
rules.compact: Applied when the component is up to 768px wide. Hides first and last and shows fewer pages.
rules.tight: Applied when the component is up to 480px wide. Shows only the first, current and last pages.
rules.bar: `<ul>` list with the buttons. Receives `classNames.controls` and `classNames.list`.
rules.edges: `<li>` of the first, previous, next and last buttons.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They are defined on `.gem-pagination` and none are written inline, so you can change them from your own class (`.gem-pagination.my-class`) or with Tailwind utilities. The dark theme uses other values.

items.--gem-pagination-bg: Background of the bar and buttons.
items.--gem-pagination-border: Bar border and dividers between buttons.
items.--gem-pagination-accent: Button color and current page background.

items.--gem-space-3: Vertical gap between the summary, bar and selector.
items.--gem-space-4: Horizontal gap between the summary, bar and selector.
items.--gem-radius-md: Rounded corners of the bar and of the buttons in `ghost`.
items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring of the buttons in `ghost`.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the `<nav>`.

items.page: Current page, starting at 1. Controlled mode.
items.defaultPageSize: Initial items per page. Uncontrolled mode.
items.showSummary: Shows the result range. With a function, customizes the text.
items.siblingCount: Pages visible on each side of the current one.
items.boundaryCount: Pages fixed at the start and end. Minimum 1.
items.showFirstLast: Adds the first and last page buttons.
items.variant: Visual style: joined bar (`outlined`) or separate buttons (`ghost`).
items.onPageChange: Called when the page changes. Receives the new page.
items.onPageSizeChange: Called when the page size changes. Receives the new value.

labels.title: Texts
labels.description: Accessible names and visible texts. All default to English.

items.pageSizeLabel: Visible text next to the selector.
items.firstLabel: Accessible name of the first page button.
items.previousLabel: Accessible name of the previous page button.
items.nextLabel: Accessible name of the next page button.
items.lastLabel: Accessible name of the last page button.
items.pageLabel: Returns the accessible name of each page button. Receives the page number.

range.title: PaginationRange
range.description: Object passed to `showSummary` when it is a function.

items.start: Position of the first item on the page. `0` if there are no items.
items.end: Position of the last item on the page.
